en:
A real System Design techtalk hosted by EngineerPro

Want to see how we teach before you sign up? This is a System Design techtalk our team ran for the community, walking through one real problem end to end: how TikTok serves 2.1 million concurrent realtime viewers — pinning down the requirements, estimating scale, then landing on the final architecture. Exactly the kind of question a Big Tech System Design round asks.
